CREDITS - Warehouse & Logistics Kit
Third-party material (CC0 1.0 Universal, public domain dedication, redistribution allowed). 1k files from polyhaven.com, adjusted by us.
- concrete_floor_worn_001 - photography Dimitrios Savva, processing Rico Cilliers - https://polyhaven.com/a/concrete_floor_worn_001 - CC0 1.0 (T_ConcreteFloor, _N, _MR)
- corrugated_iron_03 by Charlotte Baglioni - https://polyhaven.com/a/corrugated_iron_03 - CC0 1.0 (T_Cladding, _N, _MR; T_CabinPanel is a whitened copy)
- painted_metal_shutter - photography Charlotte Baglioni, processing Rico Cilliers, baking Dario Barresi - https://polyhaven.com/a/painted_metal_shutter - CC0 1.0 (T_Shutter, _N, _MR)
- plywood by Rob Tuytel - https://polyhaven.com/a/plywood - CC0 1.0 (T_Plywood, _N, _MR)
The words on signs, screens and labels were rasterised with Fredoka (SIL Open Font License 1.1); the font file is not included.
Everything else (all models; signs, floor stencils, stretch film, tread plate and the maps reused from our Factory, Store, Gas Station and Apartment kits) is our own work,
generated by our own code. No AI image generator was used for any texture.
